auditMetadata.target: USER Resume Builder & Candidate Dashboard Studio

categories.name: Information Architecture & Step Structure
categories.findings: All 11 canonical steps (Heading, Work History, Education, Skills, Projects, Certifications, Languages, Summary, Achievements, References, Review & Export) are strictly sequenced and navigable.
categories.evidence: src/components/BuildResume/BuildResume.jsx orderedSteps array and canonical step routing.

categories.name: Horizontal Step Ribbon & Scrolling
categories.findings: Smooth scroll ribbon with left/right chevrons, auto-centering on active step, and zero horizontal clipping.

categories.name: All 11 Steps Stepper Overview Modal
categories.findings: Interactive modal displaying 3-column matrix of all 11 sections with live completion badges, counters, and 1-click jump.

categories.name: Contextual AI Studio Micro-Guidance
categories.findings: Top guidance banner dynamically renders step-specific ATS hints, keyword rules, and entry counters.

categories.name: ATS Career Readiness Integration
categories.findings: First-class interactive header pill (ATS: XX/100) linked to slide-over diagnostic companion drawer with radial gauge.

categories.name: Studio Top Header Hierarchy
categories.findings: Clean 3-zone flexbox header separating navigation, ATS intelligence, and quick actions with zero overlapping.

categories.name: Fixed Bottom Action Bar & Safe Padding
categories.findings: Sticky frosted-glass footer with dynamic Prev/Next titles and pb-32 safe canvas padding preventing input occlusion.

categories.name: Real-Time Auto-Save & State Synchronization
categories.findings: Debounced auto-save with pulse state indicators, local recovery fallback, and optimistic UI updates.

categories.name: Live Split Studio & Fullscreen Preview
categories.findings: Split studio preview dock for wide displays plus instant high-fidelity fullscreen preview modal.

categories.name: 51-Template Selection Catalog
categories.findings: 1-click template selection modal rendering 51 authentic template cards with instant real-time live preview.

categories.name: Multi-Format Export Pipeline
categories.findings: Seamless PDF export via native print pipeline and high-fidelity DOCX generation across all 51 templates.

categories.name: Section Completion Detection Engine
categories.findings: isStepCompleted inspects substantive data structures (e.g. valid names, employment arrays, skill counts) in real-time.

categories.name: AI Content Generation & Enhancement
categories.findings: Context-aware AI summary generation and work description enhancers with deduplication and rich context injection.

categories.name: Desktop (1440x900) Visual Presentation
categories.findings: Flawless desktop layout with balanced breathing room, distinct typography, and Material 3 design tokens.

categories.name: Laptop (1280x720) Responsive Adaptation
categories.findings: Clean step ribbon scrolling with chevrons, auto-truncated title, and preserved header actions.

categories.name: Compact Desktop & Tablet Adaptation (1024 & 768)
categories.findings: Graceful collapsing of secondary badges while preserving primary ATS and Stepper interactions.

categories.name: Mobile (390x844) Viewport Experience
categories.findings: Collapsible mobile navigation drawer, full-width touch cards, and sticky bottom touch CTA bar.

categories.name: Accessibility, ARIA & Keyboard Navigation
categories.findings: Proper role dialog, aria-modal, aria-current step attributes, and Escape key dismissal on all overlays.

categories.name: Design Tokens, Typography & Color Harmony
categories.findings: Tailored HSL indigo/slate palette, emerald completion badges, and high-contrast typography.
categories.evidence: Inter font family and Tailwind CSS utility tokens.

categories.name: Reliability & Automated Test Verification
categories.findings: 421/421 tests passing across 19 suites with zero regressions or type errors.

summary.recommendation: Ready for local candidate user sign-off. Zero remote pushes performed.
